# Burning [Hazard]

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Exploration > Hazards](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#BurningHazard)*

A burning creature or object takes 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. As an action, you can extinguish fire on yourself by giving yourself the [Prone](../../Conditions/Prone.md) condition and rolling on the ground. The fire also goes out if it is doused, submerged, or suffocated.
